Historical customers include Ford and Volkswagen. Plant 3 expansion delayed to 2026

research.summary: SK On's Seosan complex is the company's sole Korean production base, running since 2018 at 5 GWh (P1+P2). A major 14 GWh Plant 3 expansion under a 1.5 trillion won investment is underway but was delayed one year to December 2026 due to EV market softness. Total target capacity of 20 GWh by 2028 across all three plants. SK On will add a 3 GWh LFP ESS line and launch Korea's first EREV battery production (NCM pouch) in H2 2026 for Hyundai Motor/Genesis. Ford was a major historical customer but the SK On-Ford relationship has faced reported strain.

companies.notes: ASPILSAN Enerji is a subsidiary of the Turkish Armed Forces Foundation (OYAK). Located in Kayseri, Turkey. Mass production of INR18650A28 NMC cylindrical cells (18650, 2900 mAh, 3.68V) began June 2022. Annual capacity: 220 MWh / ~21 million cells. research.summary: ASPILSAN Enerji, a Turkish Armed Forces Foundation (OYAK) subsidiary in Kayseri, began mass production of its 18650 NMC cylindrical cells in June 2022 — claiming to be Europe's first mass producer of Li-ion 18650 cells. Annual capacity is 220 MWh (21 million cells/year). The INR18650A28 cell is domestically designed with all IP held by ASPILSAN. Primary customers are Turkish defense and aerospace programs. A 21700 format was demonstrated in 2024 but mass production not yet confirmed.

research.summary: Siro is a JV between Turkish EV maker TOGG and Chinese battery manufacturer Farasis Energy, located in Gemlik, Bursa. Module and pack production (using imported cells) began in April 2023 at 3 GWh/year capacity. The adjacent cell factory broke ground in April 2023 with cell production targeted for 2026. Phase 1 cell capacity is 8 GWh/year, scaling to 20 GWh by 2031. The facility will initially use Farasis NMC pouch cell technology and plans to serve TOGG EVs plus third-party customers across automotive and stationary storage.
